main_text.p: {a} 1. Corinth. 11, v. 23. 24. 25. Ego enim accepi à Domino quod & tradidi vobis, Dominum Iesum, videlicet ea nocte qua proditus est, accepisse panem: Et gratias actis fregisse, ac dixisse, Accipite, edite: hoc meum est corpus quod pro vobis frangitur: hoc facite ad mei recordationem : Item & poculum, postquam cœnassent, dicedo, Hoc poculum est Novum illud testamentum, per meum sanguinem: hoc facite, quotiescunque biberitis, ad mei recordationem.

page.notes: The page is a two-column scan; the left column is italic and the right column roman. The reference mark "a" heading the right column and the letters b and c in the left column were read from the scan; the right column's first line is partly obscured. Words at the foot of the left column ("cor-") run over into the right column's text. Some words are uncertain, notably "Item" and "Dicedo", which may be misread. Ligatures and abbreviations such as "q;" have been normalised to the printed letters where readable. The reading of the catchword "perū" is doubtful.
